mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, nickname, phone, email, user_type, status, last_login_time, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (id, username, password, nickname, phone, email, user_type, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{userType}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
